title: Recommendations of the Mosque of Kheef
categoryChain: Recommendations of the Mosque of Kheef
introduction:
RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE MOSQUE OF KHEEF

1. It is recommended that a pilgrim performs his recommended and obligatory prayers of day and night in the Kheef mosque only. The best place to do so is at the place of prayer of the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.).

2. Recite a hundred times:

3. Performing six units of prayers at the actual site of the Mosque. It is better to perform this prayer on 13th Zilhijj before returning to Mecca.

verses.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اﷲِ، لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اﷲُ، اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ
